cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Obey Without Explanation
cards.instruction: Create increasingly inconvenient requests that test whether someone accepts your authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave your desk and stand by the open window, please. We'll start with following one clear instruction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Instruction first, questions afterward. I'd like to establish that my team can manage that order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's freezing. Can I get my coat?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Fetch mine too, then hold it by the window while I finish at my desk. Where I can see you, please.

reason: Remove imaginary wrong-coat correction; B comfort request now causes explicit extra service and continued visible obedience at the cold window.
